decision: Microsoft identity comes from the id_token only. Drop the Graph /me call. Trust table: UPN and xms_edov emails are IdP-verified; plain email claims count only when the host enrolled the token tid. Autoroute needs enrolled domain and enrolled tid on one host. First sign-in binds tid+oid to the user row.
why: Graph mail and otherMails are attacker-settable in the attacker's own tenant. UPN suffixes are verified domains. Removing Graph removes a spoofable source instead of guarding it

decision: Skip id_token signature verification against JWKS
why: Token arrives from the token endpoint over TLS with client-secret auth. OIDC Core 3.1.3.7 step 6 allows that. A JWKS fetch adds a network dependency for no new threat covered

decision: Do not add a durable lockout counter to the catalog
